description: Produce a chunking plan and retrieval config for a set of documents and query samples. Before indexing a corpus, to fix chunk size and retrieval settings. Do not choose this when you need retrieval quality measured, which needs embeddings. Example requests: Plan the chunking for this RAG corpus. | What chunk size should I use for these documents? | Give me a retrieval config for these documents.

accepted_price.description: The quoted amount, echoed exactly; checked against the quote.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

buyer_token.description: The buyer_token returned with your first purchase. It opens the purchase history for that buyer, including earlier deliverables.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key; the same key returns the same job.

documents.description: The customer's documents.txt, as text. Supported: Plain text. Documents separated by blank lines. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

queries.description: The customer's queries.txt, as text. Supported: Plain text. Sample queries, one per line. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

payment_signature.description: x402 payment payload; required for a priced capability (see submit_job).

quote_id.description: The quote_id from POST /v1/jobs; required when priced.

name: submit_rag_chunking_plan
title: RAG chunking plan
